name: -6 AN to 1/4" NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter
title: -6 AN to 1/4" NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter
description:
The -6 AN to 1/4" NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN to NPT Male 90 Degree Swivel Adapter Fittings are precision CNC-machined to connect 37-degree AN hose ends to NPT threaded ports while providing a compact 90-degree routing solution. The swivel design allows for easy clocking and precise alignment, making these adapters ideal for fuel, oil, coolant, boost, transmission, and power steering systems where space is limited.

Manufactured from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process, these adapters deliver superior strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. Precision-cut tapered NPT threads provide a secure mechanical seal (thread sealant recommended), while the true 37-degree AN flare ensures a reliable, leak-free connection in high-pressure and high-temperature environments.

Compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuel, pump gas, diesel, oil, coolant, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, and air systems, these AN to NPT 90° swivel fittings are ideal for street performance, racing, off-road, marine, and custom fabrication projects.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for maximum fluid velocity in tight engine bays.
• Thread Pitch: Precision NPT tapered threads for leak-free sealing in blocks and cells.
